## Purpose

## Verification

State the working directory, exact commands, exit statuses and evidence paths.

## Evidence and scope

- [ ] Claims link to the changed source or committed artifact.
- [ ] Generated figures retain their inputs, generation command and evidence state.
- [ ] Missing measurements, approvals and unavailable inputs remain explicit.
- [ ] No secrets, restricted raw data or unapproved disclosure are included.

List remaining limitations. A checked PR box is not author, PI or safety approval.
